title: Validate successful LTE attach and detach for single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE
UE placed under excellent LTE RSRP radio conditions as defined in Clause 4.6
All other cells powered off
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup as per test configuration and ensure serving LTE cell is activated and unloaded.
Place UE in the center of the cell close to the radiated eNB antenna to ensure excellent LTE RSRP.
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE and wait for successful LTE attach procedure completion.
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN as per test configuration.
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful LTE detach procedure completion.
Stop and save the logs.
Repeat steps 3 to 7 for a total of 10 iterations.
Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (minimum, average, maximum).
expectedResults: 100% attach and detach success rate over 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded correctly
UE successfully attached to the correct cell each iteration
No connectivity issues during attach/detach
Logs captured with complete signaling and call flow
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach/detach success messages
Validate signaling messages in test logs
Check UE cell parameters (PCI, eNB ID, ARFCN) in logs
Measure latency timestamps from attach request to attach complete

title: Validate successful 5G NSA attach and detach with secondary node addition and release for single UE
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully perform 5G NSA attach and detach procedures including secondary node addition and release 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE
UE placed under excellent 5G SS-RSRP radio conditions as defined in Clause 4.6
All other cells powered off
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup as per test configuration and ensure serving LTE and 5G cells are activated and unloaded.
Place UE in the center of the cell close to the radiated eNB/gNB antennas for excellent 5G SS-RSRP.
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE and wait for successful 5G NSA attach procedure completion including Secondary Node addition (EN-DC).
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN as per test configuration.
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful 5G NSA detach procedure completion including Secondary Node release.
Stop and save the logs.
Repeat steps 3 to 7 for a total of 10 iterations.
Calculate and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (minimum, average, maximum).
expectedResults: 100% attach, secondary node addition, and detach success rates over 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded correctly
UE successfully attached to the correct LTE and 5G cells each iteration
Secondary node added and released successfully each iteration
No connectivity issues during attach/detach
Logs captured with complete signaling and call flow
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach/detach and secondary node addition/release success messages
Validate signaling messages in test logs including SgNB Addition Request and Release messages
Check UE cell parameters (PCI, eNB ID, gNB ID, ARFCN, NR-ARFCN) in logs
Measure latency timestamps from attach request to attach complete

title: Validate attach failure and recovery when UE power ON is attempted under poor radio conditions
description: Verify that the LTE/5G NSA attach procedure fails when UE is placed under poor radio conditions below the minimum coupling loss and that appropriate error handling or recovery mechanisms are triggered.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE
UE placed under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss threshold defined in Clause 4.6
All other cells powered off
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup as per test configuration and ensure serving cell is activated.
Place UE in cell edge or shielded environment to simulate poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss.
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE and attempt LTE or 5G NSA attach procedure.
Observe and record attach failure messages or timeouts.
Verify that no attach success is reported and proper error or retry mechanisms are triggered by UE or network.
Power OFF the UE and stop logging.
Repeat for 3 iterations to confirm consistent behavior.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails due to poor radio conditions
No attach success messages in logs
Error or retry mechanisms are triggered appropriately
No false attach success recorded
Logs capture failure causes and related signaling
verificationMethods: Analyze UE and network logs for attach failure and error codes
Validate absence of attach complete messages
Check UE retry or recovery procedures in logs

title: Validate detach failure recovery when UE power OFF is not detected properly
description: Verify that the network and UE handle failure scenarios where UE power OFF or detach signaling is not completed or acknowledged properly.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE
UE attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell under excellent radio conditions
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup and attach UE successfully.
Start logs to capture signaling messages.
Simulate UE power OFF but block or drop detach request or detach accept signaling messages.
Observe network and UE behavior for timeout or retry of detach procedure.
Verify that network releases resources properly after timeout or triggers recovery.
Stop logs and record observations.
Repeat for 3 iterations.
expectedResults: Detach procedure failure is detected
Network triggers timeout and resource cleanup after failed detach
UE retries detach or initiates recovery
No resource leak or stuck UE context in network
Logs capture failure and recovery signaling
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling flow in logs for missing or failed detach messages
Validate network resource release after detach failure
Check UE behavior for retries or recovery

Power OFF the UE and wait for successful detach.
Repeat for 10 iterations.
Record KPIs including attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency.
expectedResults: 100% attach and detach success rate at minimum coupling loss
Attach latency within expected limits
No connectivity issues

UE configured with valid credentials
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup and activate serving cell.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions.
Start logging signaling messages including authentication exchanges.
Power ON UE and initiate attach procedure.
Verify that authentication and authorization messages are exchanged successfully.
Power OFF UE and initiate detach procedure.
Check that security contexts are properly released.
Stop logging and save data.
expectedResults: Authentication and authorization succeed for attach

title: Validate inter-node signaling during 5G NSA secondary node release initiated by MN
description: Verify correct signaling flow and resource release when the MN initiates Secondary Node Release procedure as per Clause 10.4.1.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN configured
UE attached to LTE and NR cells
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Establish 5G NSA attach with secondary node addition.
Trigger MN initiated secondary node release by sending SgNB Release Request message.
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message.
Check MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration.
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages.
Confirm SN releases UE context upon UE Context Release message.
Capture and analyze signaling messages for correctness.
expectedResults: MN initiated SN Release signaling follows defined procedure
SCG configuration released successfully at UE
SN resources released and data forwarding handled correctly
All messages exchanged in correct order
verificationMethods: Check signaling flows between MN and SN
Verify UE receives proper RRC reconfiguration
Analyze timing and order of messages

Capture and analyze signaling messages for correctness.
expectedResults: SN initiated SN Release signaling follows defined procedure
SCG configuration released successfully at UE
SN resources released and data forwarding handled correctly
All messages exchanged in correct order
verificationMethods: Check signaling flows between SN and MN
Verify UE receives proper RRC reconfiguration
Analyze timing and order of messages
